test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **Select the sentences that contain no spelling errors.**

options.text: Many communities in the world still feel that their voices and positions have been dissenfranchised.
Many communities in the world still feel that their voices and positions have been dysenfranchised.
Many communities in the world still feel that their voices and positions have been dysenfrenchized.
Many communities in the world still feel that their voices and positions have been disenfranchised.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Many communities in the world still feel that their voices and positions have been disenfranchised.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The error here lies in the spelling of "**Disenfranchised**"
